# Cardputer CodeSpace OS

> Use a Cardputer ADV and a touch TFT to control an XFCE desktop running in GitHub Codespaces.

CS OS was used on the development Codespace. The public bootstrap still needs an end-to-end test on a fresh Codespace. Audio can drop out and video can slow down when the desktop is busy.
